employees.evidence: we invest in our employees to ensure they have every opportunity to grow professionally and excel

shareholders.evidence: develop energy resources safely, profitably and responsibly to maximize value

integrity.evidence: We demand integrity and personal accountability at every level of the company

safety.evidence: an unwavering commitment to safety and environmental stewardship

innovation.evidence: We promote innovation that improves processes and results

result.analyst_notes: Mostly aspirational and absolute, using firm words such as demand and unwavering commitment. Written in first-person plural. Financial results and value lead, framed around partners and investors. Integrity, innovation and investment form a distinctive triad, and the page treats safety and stewardship as conditions of the mission.
